description_en: Stops a job instance in the running state
description_zh: 终止某次正在运行的实例
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 stop-instance --job-id 92583 --instance-id 11111111 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the job. You can obtain the ID of the job on the Task Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the job instance in the running state
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned only if an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，仅错误时返回错误信息
Message.example: Your request is denied as lack of ssl protect.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
终止任务运行是否成功。取值如下：

true：终止任务运行成功。
false：终止任务运行失败
